name: erp-portal
description: Être Patisserie wholesale ERP portal - Express API + React client

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run server:dev" "npm run client:dev"
scripts.client:build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.client:build:dev: cd client && npm install && npm run build:dev
scripts.client:build:prod: cd client && npm install && npm run build:prod
scripts.build-and-serve: npm run build:prod && npm run server:prod
scripts.build-and-serve-dev: npm run build:dev && npm run server:dev
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.reset-db: node server/backup.js label before-reset && rm -f server/erp.db server/erp.db-shm server/erp.db-wal && echo Database deleted after a backup in backups/ - it will be re-seeded on next start

author: Être Patisserie
